name: Buzz
description: Combines team chat, a Git forge and AI agents on the Nostr protocol, giving each agent a cryptographic identity and scoped permissions inside a self-hostable workspace.

skills.name: Cryptographic Agent Identity
skills.description: Issues each agent a Nostr keypair so its actions in chat and code review are attributable and permission-scoped.

skills.name: Integrated Git Forge
skills.description: Hosts repositories, patches and reviews alongside chat so agents can open and discuss changes in one workspace.

skills.name: Coding Agent Harnesses
skills.description: Runs Goose, Codex and Claude Code as workspace participants that respond to messages and work on repositories.
